category: Cloudreve-family drive with native S3 and WebDAV

free_tier.stated: 100 GB on registration plus 400 GB earned by daily check-in, so 500 GB is reachable on a free account but only through a login streak. The free plan also carries 1 TB of monthly bandwidth
free_tier.notes: the pricing block reads '100GB Storage +400GB via check-in' and the check-in panel says 'up to 500GB free'

per_object_cap.stated: 32212254720 bytes (30 GiB) per upload, as the site's published config.json sets limit.upload_allow_max_size

retention.stated: Not published. The 400 GB is drip-fed by daily check-in, so an account that stops logging in cannot earn the rest

egress.terms: 1 TB per month on the free Starter tier, published, then paid. Direct links are served from per-user subdomains with Cache-Control: public, max-age=15552000

tooling: rclone s3 against s3.1yunpan.com, rclone webdav, s3cmd, any S3 SDK, and a raw GET on the per-user host. Registration is an email address and an emailed six-digit code with no phone field in the DOM; Google and GitHub OAuth are also offered
chaining: The strongest chaining candidate in its group: a free bucket that answers both S3 and WebDAV drops into a chunk-and-replicate scheme as a first-class target with no AList shim. The 1 TB monthly bandwidth is the binding number, not the 500 GB of space

limits.value: 1 TB of bandwidth per month on the free tier
400 of the 500 GB is granted 5 GB at a time by daily check-in

identity_cost.detail: an email address at one of a fixed list of domains (including gmail.com, qq.com, icloud.com, 163.com and yahoo.com) and an emailed six-digit code; the register form has username, password, confirm, email, email_code and an agreement checkbox with no phone or mobile input present

reliability_note: Reads are real: a 1,326,142,372-byte MP4 came back byte-exact against Content-Length with Range honoured, and a ranged GET returned 206 with a correct Content-Range. The site notice states that files uploaded between 2026-10-05_22:00:00 and 2026-10-30_23:59:59 are temporarily not downloadable and that file upload is temporarily stopped, and config.json sets upload.temporarily_disabled to true. The 400 GB is streak-gated, so an account that stops logging in loses headroom

evidence.proved: rendered pricing 'Starter CNY 0/month, 1TB Monthly Bandwidth, 100GB Storage +400GB via check-in'
HTTP 200, Content-Length 1326142372, 1326142372 bytes downloaded, sha256 04b36ea0dc7a3bac5776b37432e16ad6d5a560a7da32b1ad7efbf00bfb5b6be7, so a 1.33 GB object came back byte-exact
Range bytes=1000000-1000255 returned HTTP 206 with Content-Range bytes 1000000-1000255/1326142372 and 256 bytes
HTTP 400 with S3 XML InvalidArgument / Invalid path, and /testbucket returned 403 AccessDenied / Missing AWS authentication, so it is a real S3 implementation
403 AccessDenied with real S3 error semantics rather than a stub
the form DOM has username, password, confirm, email, email_code and 2FA support, and zero phone or mobile inputs
the site config sets the per-upload size limit to 32212254720 bytes
the config disables registration with any email domain and carries an email_whitelist of permitted domains
the front page carries a notice that files uploaded in a stated window are temporarily not downloadable, older files are unaffected, and file upload is temporarily stopped
evidence.quote: 技术故障导致 2026-10-05_22:00:00 至 2026-10-30_23:59:59 期间上传的文件暂时无法下载，技术人员正在维护系统并从冷备份中恢复，我们会尽快恢复文件的正常下载。对于 2026-10-05:20:00:00 以前上传的文件均可正常下载未受影响。系统目前暂时停止文件上传功能。

evidence.proved: the config the web app loads sets upload.temporarily_disabled to true
a HEAD on the demo MP4 answers HTTP 200 with Content-Length 1326142372
a ranged GET returns the matching Content-Range, so Range is honoured on the direct host
the S3 endpoint answers an S3-shaped XML error body to an unauthenticated GET of the root
the front-page Starter plan lists 1 TB of monthly bandwidth
the front-page Starter plan still lists 100 GB of storage plus 400 GB via check-in

price_per_tb_month: Pro at CNY 29/month is 1 TB storage and 10 TB/month; the free tier is not purchasable and has no per-terabyte price
binding_note: One 1 TiB refill would exhaust a month in a single morning.
notes: 500 GB reachable on an email address with no phone is unusual, and the S3 endpoint answering real S3 error semantics is what makes it useful: rclone, restic and Duplicati can each treat an account as a bucket. The check-in ladder is a daily quota rather than a wall-clock trial, so it is repeatable, but it also means the account is worth less the moment the streak stops.

extras.fronting: direct links carry Server: cloudflare and CF-Cache-Status: DYNAMIC
